status: Research only; definitions, types, validation and choice IDs require approval.

usageLegend.M: source-backed per-record content or required submission data in indicated scope
usageLegend.C: conditional or scheme/portfolio-level expectation; see report
usageLegend.R: recommended; may be recommended by source or inferred design

deliveryLegend.entry: candidate built from established planning baseline; not approved for release
deliveryLegend.review: awaits narrower verification or UX approval
deliveryLegend.portfolio: research only; keep out of ordinary Add Field

schemeScopes.NMC: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates
schemeScopes.NZ_NURSING: New Zealand enrolled and registered nurses

schemeScopes.CNO: Ontario nurses, General or Extended class

schemeScopes.NICEIC: NICEIC-certified electrical businesses and sole traders

definitions.label: Activity title
definitions.purpose: Identify the activity succinctly.

usage.profession: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates

definitions.validation: Trim text; use title or meaningful description for drafts.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Share identity across schemes; course provider is separate.

definitions.label: Activity date
definitions.purpose: Record the activity or completion date according to the applicable scheme.

usage.profession: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates
New Zealand enrolled and registered nurses

definitions.validation: Date-only; preserve recorded calendar day; do not use as creation revision.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Reuse canonical date; scheme-specific completion rule belongs to policy.

definitions.label: Activity start date
definitions.purpose: Record start of an activity spanning multiple dates.

usage.profession: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates
New Zealand enrolled and registered nurses

definitions.validation: Cannot follow activity completion date.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Activity range component; distinct from a regulatory cycle.

definitions.label: Activity description
definitions.purpose: Describe the activity and context so the entry is intelligible later.

usage.profession: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates

definitions.validation: Plain text; avoid identifiable third-party information.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Reuse standard details or an approved scheme label; distinguish from reflection.

definitions.label: Learning provider
definitions.purpose: Identify the organisation that provided or verified the learning.
definitions.validation: Text; preserve official name. Provider name alone does not establish eligibility.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Reusable name field; certificate and approval number stay separate.

definitions.label: Provider approval reference
definitions.purpose: Capture the recognised provider identifier where applicable.
definitions.validation: Preserve leading zeros; external verification is a user action.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Scheme-specific eligibility; use text, independent of provider name.

definitions.label: Learning method
definitions.purpose: Describe how the learning took place in the user’s own words.

usage.profession: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates
IET members and applicable registered engineers

definitions.validation: Short informative text; do not infer hours from description.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Free-text method remains distinct from controlled categories.

definitions.label: HCPC learning category
definitions.purpose: Classify learning for a portfolio mix check.
definitions.validation: Identify one applicable category for summary; validate classification with owner.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Schema reusable; exact vocabulary scoped to HCPC.

definitions.label: Social Work England activity type
definitions.purpose: Capture portal type for transfer of a reflective record.
definitions.validation: Map only to current portal options; allow required Other explanation.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Separate from HCPC and other category vocabularies.

definitions.label: Course or certificate reference
definitions.purpose: Retain a searchable reference printed on a record or certificate.
definitions.validation: Preserve original formatting; allow blank.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: A source reference is independent of provider approval ID and evidence file.

definitions.label: Learning objective
definitions.purpose: Describe what the professional intended to learn.

usage.profession: IET members and applicable registered engineers

definitions.validation: Allow early draft; avoid duplicating a bound role-plan item.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Generic text works across schemes; distinct from addressing a need or linking a plan.

definitions.label: Learning need and how identified
definitions.purpose: Capture the need, how it was identified and why it matters.

usage.profession: Ontario nurses, General or Extended class

definitions.validation: Prompt for origin of need if relevant; author drafts in own words.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Related to objectives, with different semantics. SRA uses it in evidence of competence.

definitions.label: Development plan reference
definitions.purpose: Identify the learning plan objective addressed by an activity.

usage.profession: IET members and applicable registered engineers
Ontario nurses, General or Extended class

definitions.validation: Use a short traceable label; a formal plan has its own scope and dates.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Shared reference concept; later entity linkage may replace text without erasing history.

definitions.label: Relevance to my practice
definitions.purpose: Explain why the topic is relevant to role, registration or learning goals.

usage.profession: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates

definitions.validation: Use the scheme prompt or bind to existing details; avoid collecting the same answer twice.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Reusable description facet; a planned objective may be different.

definitions.label: What I learned
definitions.purpose: Record the knowledge, skills or judgement gained.

usage.profession: IET members and applicable registered engineers

definitions.validation: Use scheme word guidance as readiness feedback; preserve line breaks.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Generic outcome; impact and action are distinct when a scheme asks separately.

definitions.label: Peer reflection
definitions.purpose: Describe learning gained from a discussion with a peer.
definitions.validation: Suppress identifiable details; annual requirement checked separately; word guidance from current form.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Scoped field; dialogue is distinct from ordinary private reflection.

definitions.label: Reflective account reference
definitions.purpose: Link to a separately maintained reflective account.

usage.profession: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates

definitions.validation: Never represent an entry note as the mandatory approved NMC form.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Reference only. Approved revalidation form is a portfolio-level document.

definitions.label: Impact on professional practice
definitions.purpose: Explain observed or intended changes in professional practice.
definitions.validation: Permit prospective or observed outcome as scheme allows; retain personal text privately where appropriate.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Shared impact concept. For SWE combine with people impact in the portal prompt.

definitions.label: Benefit to service users
definitions.purpose: Describe benefit sought or achieved for others.
definitions.validation: Require anonymisation; use combined prompt where applicable.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Separate from practitioner’s own learning; merge presentation only when the scheme does.

definitions.label: Follow-up action
definitions.purpose: Record next action or an unresolved development need.

usage.profession: IET members and applicable registered engineers
Ontario nurses, General or Extended class

definitions.validation: Optional draft; do not misrepresent future action as completed CPD.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Generic action; distinct from completed action or due date.

definitions.label: Review date
definitions.purpose: Record an intended review date when planning follow-up.

usage.profession: Ontario nurses, General or Extended class

definitions.validation: Future dates allowed; never included in activity period calculations.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Plan metadata or optional personal field; separate from canonical activity date.

definitions.label: Credited CPD duration
definitions.purpose: Retain the existing credited duration of an activity.

usage.profession: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates
IET members and applicable registered engineers
New Zealand enrolled and registered nurses

definitions.validation: Nonnegative integer minutes; no rounding individual activities without a verified rule.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Canonical binding. Unit conversions or evidence eligibility are reporting policy.

definitions.label: Participatory CPD time
definitions.purpose: Record the portion of credited time spent in participatory learning.

usage.profession: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates

definitions.validation: Zero to credited minutes; distinguish blank from explicit zero.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Shared duration type, distinct meaning from credits, ethics or formal learning.

definitions.label: Ethics CPD time
definitions.purpose: Record the ethics portion where a scheme tracks it.
definitions.validation: Zero to credited minutes; verified ethics qualification comes from scheme policy.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Reusable duration concept; CPA or ICAEW minimums remain scoped.

definitions.label: Verifiability
definitions.purpose: Classify whether a whole activity meets applicable verifiability criteria.
definitions.validation: Blank is unclassified; confirmation requires chosen scheme evidence and scope checks.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Reusable classification structure. ACCA hours convert to units through its own scheme rule.

definitions.label: GDC evidence eligibility
definitions.purpose: Capture whether evidence is sufficient for the user to count the activity towards GDC totals.
definitions.validation: Blank defaults to unconfirmed; claim requires qualifying evidence or a traceable reference.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Different evidence criteria from ACCA. Do not sum merely because an attachment exists.

definitions.label: Formal learning classification
definitions.purpose: Classify activity against the selected scheme’s recognised formal learning definition.

usage.profession: Qualified CII, PFS and SMB members

definitions.validation: Vocabulary and eligibility must be pinned to the selected body and date.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Formal and structured are not interchangeable across schemes. Use jurisdiction-specific variants when validated.

definitions.label: CORU credits claimed
definitions.purpose: Record credits claimed under the applicable CORU board rule.
definitions.validation: Nonnegative exact decimal; retain scheme; confirm allowed increments for the specific board.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Distinct unit. A timed activity cannot determine these credits automatically.

definitions.label: California RN contact hours
definitions.purpose: Capture exact contact hours recognised by the provider.
definitions.validation: Nonnegative exact decimal; retain source and scope; duplicate course claims need review.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Distinct from elapsed or credited minutes. Never apply a general conversion.

definitions.label: Prior-year credit carried forward
definitions.purpose: Record a user-confirmed allowance applied to a reporting cycle.
definitions.validation: Check scope, bounds and originating period under policy; prevent counting it as an activity.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Report-level adjustment. Separate from new activity minutes.

definitions.label: Relevant part of the NMC Code
definitions.purpose: Map an activity to relevant parts of the NMC Code.

usage.profession: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates

definitions.validation: Select one or more relevant official Code themes. Preserve chosen theme IDs across revisions.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Scope to this edition of the NMC Code.

definitions.label: GDC development outcomes
definitions.purpose: Capture the applicable GDC development outcomes.
definitions.validation: Use outcome IDs and align with evidence. Require at least one when scheme-ready.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Scope to GDC. A general competency label cannot substitute for this vocabulary.

definitions.label: Social Work England CPD standards
definitions.purpose: Capture relevant standards for portal transfer.
definitions.validation: Do not silently mark defaults in local proof. Treatment of portal defaults requires verification.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Distinct standards across versions; avoid claiming the portal record was submitted.

definitions.label: Relevant Nursing Council pou
definitions.purpose: Associate learning with the relevant scope-specific standard.

usage.profession: New Zealand enrolled and registered nurses

definitions.validation: Use correct EN or RN version; do not transfer selections across unlike scopes.
definitions.choiceReviewNote: pending scope-specific official wording and form review
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Different from GDC outcome or NMC Code selections.

definitions.label: ARB mandatory topic
definitions.purpose: Track relevant mandatory topics in ARB drafting.
definitions.validation: Allow other valid activity; pin year and current mandated topics.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: The required topic is a scope-specific reporting concept.

definitions.label: Competency reference
definitions.purpose: Reference a standard when no approved scheme selector is available.

usage.profession: IET members and applicable registered engineers

definitions.validation: Plain text; do not infer coverage from text alone.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Generic fallback; use scoped choices when the regulator expects exact mapping.

definitions.label: Review confirmations
definitions.purpose: Record user review of a specific statement where a workflow needs it.
definitions.validation: Unchecked or null is not confirmed; do not infer endorsement, submission or third-party verification.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Generic binary type; separate authorities and signatures remain distinct.

definitions.label: Independent verification reference
definitions.purpose: Record where separate evidence of confirmation is retained.

usage.profession: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates
New Zealand enrolled and registered nurses

definitions.validation: No implied signature; restrict personally identifying details in exports.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Portfolio reference. Do not place on every activity by default.

definitions.label: Renewal declaration status
definitions.purpose: Track the user’s progress towards a separate official declaration.

usage.profession: Ontario nurses, General or Extended class
New Zealand enrolled and registered nurses

definitions.validation: User-reported states; include period and submission date at portfolio level.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: This tracks status. The official declaration remains in the authorised system.

definitions.label: Supporting evidence
definitions.purpose: Associate an original file or existing managed reference with the activity.

usage.profession: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates

definitions.validation: Preserve byte identity and missing-source state; warn about third-party data and scheme limits.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Canonical evidence pattern; accepted evidence depends on scheme and output.

definitions.label: Evidence photograph
definitions.purpose: Capture a photograph of suitable CPD evidence for later review.

usage.profession: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates

definitions.validation: Require a supported image, bounded dimensions and user consent before sharing identifiable material.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Configuration of managed attachment with a photo capture constraint.

definitions.label: External evidence reference
definitions.purpose: Describe where evidence is kept when it cannot be copied into the app.

usage.profession: UK nurses, midwives and nursing associates

definitions.validation: Accept an opaque locator; avoid credentials or sensitive case identifiers.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Reuse across schemes; do not treat a reference as evidence verification.

definitions.label: Evidence URL
definitions.purpose: Record a link to relevant supporting material.
definitions.validation: Use approved schemes such as HTTPS; explicit open only; no background fetch or assumption of continued availability.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: A typed link can be a text or managed reference configuration.

definitions.label: Additional reflection document
definitions.purpose: Attach an optional anonymised reflection document for the portal workflow.
definitions.validation: Use applicable portal formats. Exclude certificates and correspondence from this export.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Distinct evidence scope from course completion proof.

definitions.label: CII structured CPD classification
definitions.purpose: Classify activity under the CII membership definition of structured CPD.

usage.profession: Qualified CII, PFS and SMB members

definitions.validation: Confirm structured status from the member rules; do not copy other scheme classifications.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Same input shape as RICS. Scheme meaning and evidence remain separate.

definitions.label: CIOB learning theme
definitions.purpose: Assign the primary theme used in a CIOB subscription-year summary.
definitions.validation: Count time in one theme only by default; confirm multi-theme rules before enabling allocations.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Distinct from an ARB topic or RICS mandatory topic.

definitions.label: CIOB learning format
definitions.purpose: Record the recommended mix independently of mandatory themes.
definitions.validation: Display suggested balance separately from mandatory hours.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Different from formal/structured eligibility and from CIOB topic.

definitions.label: Electrical work or training scope
definitions.purpose: Describe the relevance of learning to a certified business’s work.

usage.profession: NICEIC-certified electrical businesses and sole traders

definitions.validation: Do not use a CPD entry as confirmation of competence or assessed scope.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Independent scope context can reuse short text; team competence requires a separate entity.

definitions.label: GPhC planned or unplanned learning
definitions.purpose: Identify which reflective prompts and yearly counters apply.

usage.profession: Great Britain pharmacists and pharmacy technicians

definitions.validation: Select one; count four CPD entries and planned entries separately at cycle level.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Specific to the GPhC activity form. Peer discussion and annual account are separate record kinds.

definitions.label: GPhC reflective account standard
definitions.purpose: Select the applicable standard for the separate reflective account.

usage.profession: Great Britain pharmacists and pharmacy technicians

definitions.validation: Current 2026 standard eligibility must be checked against the live form before proposing choices.
definitions.choiceReviewNote: pending nine-standard vocabulary and form cardinality review
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Portfolio or record-kind scope; do not place it on ordinary CPD activities by default.

definitions.label: Evidence redaction reviewed
definitions.purpose: Record an explicit user review before including sensitive material in a particular export.

usage.profession: Great Britain pharmacists and pharmacy technicians

definitions.validation: False or blank cannot enable a declaration of anonymity. Export selection is independent of historical retention.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Export review state, not a permanent claim about an activity or attachment.

definitions.label: Australian teaching standards addressed
definitions.purpose: Map activities to the relevant standard-level identifiers.
definitions.validation: Verify the exact official list and level before enabling choices.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Different to the CNO goals and NZ nursing scope.

definitions.label: Verifiable CPD time
definitions.purpose: Record the verified portion of a single activity when an entire activity does not qualify.
definitions.validation: Zero to credited duration. Ethics min/max can use this as the controlling subset.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Distinct from a whole-activity yes/no eligibility tag.

definitions.label: Verifiable professional ethics time
definitions.purpose: Record the qualifying ethics portion within the verifiable time.
definitions.validation: Zero to verifiable time; retain traceable documentation.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Where verified ethics is a subset of verified time, keep this meaning explicit.

definitions.label: Skills maintenance stream
definitions.purpose: Classify each entry in its New Zealand LBP stream.
definitions.validation: Only electives contribute to the elective-hour total. On-the-job entries and quizzes have separate checks.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Do not map an activity-count stream to general learning hours.

definitions.label: California MCLE awarded credit
definitions.purpose: Retain exact credit for the applicable California attorney activity.

usage.profession: California State Bar standard MCLE licensees

definitions.validation: Nonnegative. Preserve evidence and apply current mode and cap rules.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Different unit and professional scope from BRN contact hours.

definitions.label: MCLE subfield credit allocation
definitions.purpose: Represent recognised partial awards by subfield.

usage.profession: California State Bar standard MCLE licensees

definitions.validation: Avoid counting the same credit twice; enforce parent subset only after current categories are verified.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Different from toggling category labels and crediting the whole activity.

definitions.label: Singapore CPE points claimed
definitions.purpose: Record the amount requested in a personal claim.

usage.profession: Singapore nursing practising-certificate holders in applicable cohorts

definitions.validation: Maintain separately from award; user selects original claim scope.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: A claim cannot be treated as a final award.

definitions.label: Singapore CPE points awarded
definitions.purpose: Record the recognised award after checking PRS.

usage.profession: Singapore nursing practising-certificate holders in applicable cohorts

definitions.validation: Nonnegative exact value with source reference. Avoid duplicate provider and own claims.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: A separate authoritative external status is needed for progress.

definitions.label: Malta accountancy CPE category
definitions.purpose: Identify structured activity Core or Professional Development category.
definitions.validation: Core applies to eligible structured hours only; match Board form before release.
definitions.reuseAndDeduplication: Scoped category, separate from CII structured and ACCA verifiability.

nmc.code_themes.status: Official headings and multi-select CPD log rechecked

ciob.themes.status: confirmed theme labels; check allocation rule

lbp.stream.status: official streams; map current portal label before release
